title: WebSec Sandbox Execution Record
description: Every execution of an LLM-produced artifact is recorded: policy verdict, environment, hashes, captured output. Evidence at level >= E4 is only accepted if its artifact traces to one of these records.

profile.description: host-readonly, halmos, forge-fuzz and minicertora execute on the host and may only host evidence at or below E3; E4+ requires a container/VM profile

workdir_resolved.description: r36 F4 (additive): the RESOLVED directory the process actually ran in (symlinks resolved, absolute); `workdir` keeps the operator's verbatim string

enum: host (unconfined — nothing enforces readonly; deny-rule tripwires only)

container.description: Present and non-null only for container profiles run by sandbox.Sandbox: the exact isolation the command actually got. null (or absent for externally-reported records) means the isolation, if any, lives in the operator's harness.

svm_mount.description: host directory bind-mounted to /home/foundry/.svm (WEBV2_SOLC_DIR); null when unset

input_hashes.description: path -> sha256 of every input file the command read

origin.description: locally-executed: run by sandbox.Sandbox in this process. externally-reported: run by the operator's harness elsewhere and registered via sandbox.register_exec — trusted only as far as its reporter

output_capture.description: r36 F6 (additive): the deliberate cap on captured stdout/stderr plus the TRUE byte counts and truncation flags; output_withheld means the bytes were never read (a live copier held them) and the totals are unknown — null, never zero
